maxStopGateBlocks.description: session_stop blocks per gate-only run. Omit for the mode default: strict 2, auto 0.

headlessOpenGateExitCode.description: Exit code for a headless OMP process that ends with an active run whose gates are open. 0 disables. Default 3.

engagementTripwire.description: In auto/strict, treat a session that changes more than the direct budget without opening a pstack run like open gates. Default true.

directMaxFiles.description: Direct-change budget: changed files allowed without a run. Default 1.

directMaxLines.description: Direct-change budget: added+deleted lines allowed without a run. Default 20.
